case_name: Smt. Sujata W/O Rudrappa Alias Rudresh v. Rudrappa Alias Rudresh S/O Basappa

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Sujata W/O Rudrappa @ Rudresh Huded, wife
parties.respondent_defendant: Shivakumar Rudrappa @ Rudresh S/O Basappa Huded, husband

facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2018 and lived together initially. They later separated due to various reasons. The husband filed a petition for restitution of conjugal rights, which was allowed. However, the parties continued to live separately. The wife also claimed maintenance from the husband, which was granted.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish sufficient grounds for such transfer.
legal_principles.held: I have considered submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and perused the material available on record.

legal_principles.principle: A party's dependent status may be considered while deciding the transfer of a case.
legal_principles.held: That the petitioner is staying along with her parents at the address mentioned in the cause title and she has no independent source of income.

outcome.final_order: The present petition is allowed and M.C.No.193/2023 pending on the file of the Family Court, Dharwad is transferred to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Haveri.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under Section 24 CPC
advising on divorce proceedings in family court
assisting with a civil petition for admission
